members.name: avatar
members.doc: Square image URL. Initials are shown without one.

members.name: users
members.doc: Ids of the people who reacted.

members.name: body
members.doc: Plain text. "@Full Name" mentions of known people are highlighted.

members.name: createdAt
members.doc: Display label such as "2h" or "Sep 18".

members.name: deleted
members.doc: A deleted comment that still has replies keeps its place as a quiet placeholder.

types.name: CommentThreadEvent
types.doc: What changed, for syncing to a server. `comments` on `onCommentsChange` is always the full next tree.
types.text: | { type: "reply"; comment: ThreadComment; parentId: string | null } | { type: "edit"; id: string; body: string } | { type: "delete"; id: string } | { type: "react"; id: string; emoji: string; added: boolean }

types.name: CommentThreadLabels
types.doc: Every word the thread shows or announces. Each one has an English default; words with a count or a name are functions, so an app can apply its own plural rules.

members.name: thread
members.doc: Accessible name of the whole thread.

members.name: commentCount
members.doc: Header and resolved chip, such as "3 comments".

members.name: peopleCount
members.doc: Resolved chip, such as "2 people".

members.name: resolved
members.doc: Title of the resolved chip.

members.name: empty
members.doc: Shown when there are no comments.

members.name: save
members.doc: Saves an edit.

members.name: editComment
members.doc: Placeholder and accessible name of the edit field.

members.name: edited
members.doc: After the time of an edited comment.

members.name: deletedText
members.doc: Placeholder text of a deleted comment that still has replies.

members.name: deletedComment
members.doc: Accessible name of that placeholder.

members.name: replyingTo
members.doc: Above the composer while replying. The name inside it is highlighted.

members.name: reactions
members.doc: Accessible name of the reaction picker.

members.name: reactWith
members.doc: Accessible name of an emoji in the picker.

members.name: reactionCount
members.type: (emoji: string, count: number, includesYou: boolean) => string
members.doc: Accessible name of a reaction under a comment.

members.name: mentions
members.doc: Accessible name of the @mention suggestions.

types.name: CommentThreadProps
types.doc: A threaded discussion: replies nest under their comment and collapse, reactions toggle with a count that rolls, authors edit and delete their own comments in place, mentions autocomplete in the composer, and resolving folds the whole thread into a single chip that reopens it. Controlled with `comments` and `resolved`, or uncontrolled.

members.name: currentUser
members.doc: The person writing. Their comments can be edited and deleted.

members.name: people
members.doc: People who can be mentioned. Defaults to everyone in the thread.

members.name: title
members.doc: What the thread is about, shown in its header, such as "Hero headline".

members.name: reactions
members.doc: Emoji offered by the reaction picker.

members.name: maxDepth
members.doc: Replies deeper than this attach to the deepest allowed parent. Defaults to 2.

members.name: nowLabel
members.doc: Label for comments written now.

members.name: labels
members.doc: Words for localization. Leave out any key to keep its English default.
